subject: eng
title: Grammar 4A–4B Overview: Future Tense, Modals (Could/Would) & Indefinite Pronouns

questions.q: We ___ going to visit the Science Museum tomorrow afternoon.
questions.explain: 表示計劃好的將來動作，用 be going to + 原形動詞，主語 We 配 are。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: We ___ going to visit the Science Museum tomorrow afternoon.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 4A–4B Overview: Future Tense, Modals (Could/Would) & Indefinite Pronouns

questions.q: I think it ___ rain tomorrow. Remember to bring an umbrella.
questions.explain: 表示對將來的預測（tomorrow），用助動詞 will + 原形動詞 rain。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: I think it ___ rain tomorrow. Remember to bring an umbrella.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 4A–4B Overview: Future Tense, Modals (Could/Would) & Indefinite Pronouns

questions.q: When I was four years old, I ___ ride a tricycle, but I couldn't ride a bicycle.
questions.explain: 描述過去四歲時的能力（When I was four），用 can 的過去式 could。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: When I was four years old, I ___ ride a tricycle, but I couldn't ride a bicycle.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 4A–4B Overview: Future Tense, Modals (Could/Would) & Indefinite Pronouns

questions.q: ___ you like a cup of hot chocolate? Yes, please.
questions.explain: 禮貌地詢問對方想要甚麼用 Would you like ...?
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: ___ you like a cup of hot chocolate? Yes, please.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 4A–4B Overview: Future Tense, Modals (Could/Would) & Indefinite Pronouns

questions.q: Listen! There is ___ knocking at the door.
questions.explain: 肯定句中表示「有人」用不定代詞 someone / somebody。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Listen! There is ___ knocking at the door.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 4A–4B Overview: Future Tense, Modals (Could/Would) & Indefinite Pronouns

questions.q: Fill in the blank: Is there ___ (anyone / someone) in the music room now?
questions.explain: 疑問句中詢問「有沒有任何人」用 anyone。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Fill in the blank: Is there ___ (anyone / someone) in the music room now?
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 4A–4B Overview: Future Tense, Modals (Could/Would) & Indefinite Pronouns

questions.q: We use 'a few' with plural countable nouns (e.g. a few apples) and 'a little' with uncountable nouns (e.g. a little water).
questions.explain: a few 後接可數複數名詞，a little 後接不可數名詞。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: We use 'a few' with plural countable nouns (e.g. a few apples) and 'a little' with uncountable nouns (e.g. a little water).
